_doc: tool/diff_report settings (ADR-0007). Every entry that exempts a metric names its reason and decision record.

unsampledTokens.hairline: 1-pt strokes: never a flat area large enough to sample
unsampledTokens.success: no success state is drawn in the prototypes
unsampledTokens.danger: error text only (P18); no flat danger fill to sample

specTokens._doc: Values fixed by the phase-1 spec (#FFF6EE / #C9472B / #1A1A1A / #8A8A8A); a prototype raster that disagrees is reported, the spec value is kept.

geometryWaivers.ctaHeight: ADR-0019: primary buttons are 54 pt (HIG ≥ 44 pt tap target, Dynamic Type); the prototypes draw ≈ 40 pt

pageWaivers._doc: Per-page metrics that do not measure what they claim on that page; each names its reason.

P03.ctaWidth: ADR-0033: P03 is the create home with the tile picked (composer state B); its one primary action spans the composer card, while the prototype draws a separate form page with its own CTA
P03.gutter: ADR-0033: the composer of state B sits on the create home's dense gutter (SongletSpace.gutterDense, 12 pt) like P01; the prototype's 17 pt is the margin of the separate form page it draws

P04.gutter: the prototype draws the system PhotosPicker over the page; its middle band is the picker grid, not a page edge

tokenNotes.accentSoft: the prototypes use several pale tints for this role (#fbe4d8 on P05 … #fbece5 on P03, near-white grey chips on P03); #fbece5 has the lowest median ΔE of the values tried (#fbe4da 3.3, #fde9e2 2.4) and the best accent-on-tint contrast
